title: Rav Yirmiyah bar Ami
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Moed Katan 9b, disputing with Rav Huna bar Chiya about the meaning of “oil of myrrh.” This is a scribal error: the name should read Rav Yirmiyah bar Abba, as in Pesachim 43a and Megillah 13a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Moed Katan paragraph spells out Rav Huna bar Chiya. Ami versus Abba remains Hyman’s textual comparison.

The consulted Moed Katan 9b gives Rav Huna bar Chiyya for stacte and Rav Yirmeyah bar Ami for immature olive oil. Pesachim 43a instead gives Rav Huna bar Yirmeyah and Rav Yirmeyah bar Abba, respectively. Megillah 13a gives Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba for stacte and Rav Huna for immature olive oil. These different speaker profiles are preserved alongside Hyman's assertion of what SHOULD READ; they do not establish an identity merger or a correction history.
